_comment: FINMENTOR — expected HTTP security headers, machine-readable.
Source of truth for two things that must not drift apart: the policy staged in the
repository `_headers` file, and the policy a future edge layer is expected to deliver.
`delivery` is the honest part of this file. Only Referrer-Policy is actually reaching
browsers today, and it does so through a meta tag rather than a header, because
GitHub Pages cannot set response headers at all. Everything marked `staged` is inert
until an edge layer is in front of the origin.
No offline test can promote a `staged` entry to `live`. That requires a real request
against the real host — see the curl block in

headers.name: Referrer-Policy
headers.note: The only one of the six with a browser-honoured HTML equivalent.

headers.name: X-Content-Type-Options
headers.note: Header-only by specification. No meta equivalent exists.

headers.name: X-Frame-Options
headers.note: Clickjacking control. No meta equivalent exists.

headers.name: Permissions-Policy
headers.note: The old Feature-Policy meta form is dead and must not be used.

headers.name: Strict-Transport-Security
headers.note: Do not add preload until the policy has run without incident and the owner accepts that preload is slow to reverse.

headers.name: Content-Security-Policy
headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://www.google-analytics.com https://analytics.google.com https://ghennadi.app.n8n.cloud; upgrade-insecure-requests
headers.note: Must be rolled out Report-Only first. As a meta tag it is enforcing with no report-only mode, and frame-ancestors is ignored in meta form. 'unsafe-inline' is currently unavoidable because the pages carry inline scripts and styles.
